decision: Backend-owned hybrid fallback cache with Backend parser for Generate MVP and Model API evidence adapter for Analyzer wrapper.

parserOptions.decision: Use for Analyzer wrapper evidence only in MVP.
parserOptions.implementation_risk: Medium because Generate would need extra internal endpoint or analyzer dependency.
parserOptions.latency_risk: Adds service hop when used only for Generate; acceptable for Analyzer because Model API call already happens.
parserOptions.name: Model API parse-only
parserOptions.owner: Model API primary, Backend cache adapter
parserOptions.privacy_risk: Raw CV stays internal between Backend and Model API; sanitized evidence only may reach GenAI.
parserOptions.quality: Highest available parser and ATS signal quality after analyzer inference.

parserOptions.decision: Use as MVP Generate parser and shared cache owner.
parserOptions.implementation_risk: Low because Generate already reads owned CV storage.
parserOptions.latency_risk: Lowest latency for Generate because no extra service hop.
parserOptions.name: Backend parser
parserOptions.privacy_risk: Low when raw text is not cached and contact data is redacted before provider calls.
parserOptions.quality: Good enough for bounded section/skill evidence from text-like stored bytes; weak for scanned PDFs.

parserOptions.decision: Use as fallback only when same-CV latest analysis exists.
parserOptions.implementation_risk: Low but stale without source/model invalidation.
parserOptions.name: Latest analysis reuse
parserOptions.privacy_risk: Low if scoped to same user and same CV file.
parserOptions.quality: Useful fallback for ATS/actionables and section reviews when current stored bytes are weak.

parserOptions.latency_risk: Bounded by using source already available in each flow.
parserOptions.name: Hybrid fallback
parserOptions.privacy_risk: Low when all provider inputs pass shared no-leak policy.
parserOptions.quality: Best practical MVP coverage by combining model_api, backend_parser, latest_analysis_cache, metadata_only.

qualityLatencyRiskSummary.latency: No extra Model API parse-only hop for Generate in MVP.
